provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The emitted program works directly on the visible grid. It finds the two seed cells (colour palette[3]) and the obstacles (colour palette[8]). The generator always places one end of the domino on the border, with an in-bounds, non-obstacle cell beyond the other end. The program picks that free end and extends the domino's axis outward from it. It then walks step by step, painting each cell it enters with the seed colour; crossing its own path is allowed. When the next cell is an obstacle, it turns to whichever perpendicular neighbour is in bounds and not an obstacle. If no such neighbour exists, it stops. It also stops when the next step would leave the grid. The generator rejects scenes where both side cells are open or both are obstacles, so the turn is unambiguous and does not depend on the D4 transform. Grid size and direction are all read from the visible pixels. The only specialisations are the palette constants for the seed and obstacle colours, plus a tie-break order (clockwise first, mirrored to counter-clockwise first for reflected d4>=4) that keeps the archived solver's preference consistent under reflection. The background colour is never needed.
draft_notes.limitations: Assumes exactly one domino of seed colour (palette[3]) and obstacles of colour palette[8], as in the constructor. Ties between two open turn directions, and the case where one side is off-grid and the other open, are excluded by the generator. For those out-of-domain cases the program falls back to the archived clockwise-first preference, mirrored under reflection, and treats off-grid cells as blocked. The fixtures are consistent with the uniform rule. Nothing has been run or tested.
draft_notes.host_review: Visible domino determines initial direction; obstacle field determines every turn. Valid constructor scenes have exactly one non-obstacle perpendicular side at a bounce. At the boundary that side can be outside: generator exits, solver stops, and both yield the same grid. Prior notes incorrectly called all such boundary cases excluded. The solver step bound exceeds the maximum path length for 3..6 turns on 5..10 grids. Palette roles and direct coordinates reviewed; no hidden query state.
draft_notes.host_sampler_revision: Construct ray constraints with bounded randomized search, retain requested 3..6 bounces and canvas 5..10, then fill unconstrained cells with the original 20% obstacle probability. Original simulator accepts only the requested bounce count. This changes the conditioned distribution, not the ray rule; budget exhaustion returns None/raises without reducing turn count. Original supplied fixtures unchanged.
